title: Scenarij 1: phishing, kompromitovan nalog i lateralno kretanje
summary: Phishing poruka sa lažnom stranicom za prijavu, MFA umor i ukradena sesija u Entra ID-u, pivot preko VPN-a na Linux jump host, perzistencija kroz authorized_keys i cron, prelazak na server baze. Zaglavlja i SPF/DKIM/DMARC, KQL nad SigninLogs i AuditLogs, auth.log, Wazuh alarmi, obuzdavanje, vremenska linija i izvještaj.
title_en: Scenario 1: phishing, a compromised account and lateral movement
summary_en: A phishing email with a fake sign-in page, MFA fatigue and a stolen session in Entra ID, a pivot over VPN to a Linux jump host, persistence through authorized_keys and cron, and a move to the database server. Headers and SPF/DKIM/DMARC, KQL over SigninLogs and AuditLogs, auth.log, Wazuh alerts, containment, timeline and report.
